versions.notes: Repository set up: brand files, prototype, blueprint v7.
Secure API, SOT-Auth and SOT-Unbox widgets, shared pizza engine, six-slice recipient page.
Kitchen member app with live email send, SOT-App widget.
Brand palette, calmer dark mode, current pricing, Special Delivery option.
Plan IDs mapped, mid-month upgrade top-up, 14-day trial and yearly prices.
Legal acceptance at sign up and in the Kitchen, recorded with versions. Brand colors in emails.
Email packs and Special Delivery checkout through BD Digital Products, credited from BD invoices, 12-month expiry, refunds.
Removed the prototype demo sign in. I already have an account goes to the BD login page.
Login returns to the Kitchen. SOT-App 1.2.0 reports sign in problems.
Softer dark mode text. What's new shows the five newest, with a page for all. BD API uses sliceofthanks.app.
Log out in Kitchen Settings. SOT-Login widget styles the BD login page.
Pizza of the Month and Hire Gerald moved into the Kitchen behind two buttons.
Home tab (was Today) with quick starts, Pizza of the Month and This week. Gerald intro once per member. Email provider layer live (api-0.5.0).
Home: free plan wording uses the signature pizza for picked meetings.
What's new: Pizza of the Month item points to Home.
Billing inside the app (plan, payment history, change plan, update card). SOT-Join page for /join. Checkout links live.
Plan changes go to BD upgrade page. Guests who build a pizza sign up on the free form at send and get their pizza back.
Full Potato scooter art in the email, Kitchen preview and recipient page. Sender logo hops with the bike. Mailing address optional (Slice of Thanks address by default). Failed sends say so.

People on real data with real sends. CSV list sends (Pro and Team) with country and permission per row and scheduling. Name from Business in the email, recipient page and preview. Cream-backed Potato in the email. SOT-Login 1.6.1 and SOT-Join 1.0.1 px sizes.

Floating box preview with X and Pin. Note details [first name] [last name] [role] [company]. Box presets (A Slice 1, The Whole Pie 10, Pizza Party 20). Sample CSV download with Consent column. Contact role.
Meats and veggies (some Pro only), Hot Mess Express (all plans) and Heart Attack Express (Pro), sock and tiny hat retired, vegan fix, CSV upload no longer adds unsaved people.
Message picker keeps the choice, Save as preset at the bottom of the box step, Your box folds in Settings, Make every new pizza vegan, live Calendar wording.
Topping sections fold (Classic open, counts on closed ones). Sprinkle a handful, Undo and Clear move to the top of the Toppings step.
Bacon drawn as wavy strips with fat stripes.

Bake levels by time (10 sec quick, 1 min bubbly, 3 min stone-fired, 5 min Gerald's perfect bake with a Treat Jar egg). Business or Personal switch on the box step; personal pizzas drop the business parts and can carry a round photo (Pro). You card in Settings, From field on the send step. api-0.9.0: /photo route, first-name greeting.

Calendly and TidyCal connections (each member connects their own). Home This week with a pizza switch per meeting; Pro and Team send the signature pizza when a picked meeting ends, A Slice gets it waiting on Home. Personal lid message. Subject lines follow the occasion sticker. Slice of Thanks address on every email. api-0.10.2, migration calendar.sql.

Hire Gerald picks from this week's meetings and People or adds someone new; pizza message with a 16 letter limit; Gerald's pizzas get his perfect bake, five slices and chef hat confetti. Gerald wears a chef hat.

White logo and pizza envelope in the header; Pizza envelopes confetti (also after every send); envelope on the recipient page and email. Personal pizzas ride under the Slice of Thanks logo. Loaded Gerald and pizzeria classics. Gerald picks the occasion sticker from the message. First and last name for new people; vegan tag in People. Pizza of the Month folds on Home. TidyCal sync fix (date format). api-0.11.0.

Import contacts from Calendly and TidyCal into People (offered after connecting). Hire Gerald: Business or Personal, and How much topping (Light, Regular, Loaded); quick picks get the same choice. Personal sends skip the Meeting field. Header logo smaller. Email: Slice of Thanks text logo and Potato's box with the logo. api-0.12.0, migration import_contacts.sql.

Gerald is Head Chef: full box with note styles and Reserve vibes (Pro). Fixed box patterns. Pro box toppers by month. Billing window in the app. Account card with Log out and Delete my account. Pizza name explained to sender, labelled for recipient.
Billing window in brand colors with the add-card window working. Sheets fit the screen. Settings cards fold. Presets get Preview and Use it.
Browser data cleared when a different member signs in, on Log out and on Delete. Billing window scrolls once.
Card and billing address opens BD secure billing in a new tab; Billing card refreshes on return. Final sheets have no Cancel.
Account card links to BD name and email and password pages. Brand theme hides the BD account sidebar.
Tags, birthdays and anniversaries in People. Select people or a tag and send to the group. Gerald makes each person their own pizza with its own picture. Preview the first 3. Save a CSV to People.
Gerald's receipt sits straight.
+ Tag on every person card. Filter by tag always shows.
Tap a tag on any person card to filter People by it.
Kitchen Start over (tap twice). Billing steps say tap Back to the Kitchen. Dates card hidden until dates.sql is applied.
Send step Pick from People: search, tag filter, pick fills the send fields, send to everyone with a tag (Pro).
People filter by last pizza: Opened, Not opened, No pizza yet.
Use my signature pizza (Kitchen) and Send it to someone (Settings). Filter chips highlight and toggle off.
More signature pizzas (1/10/20), premade business and personal ones, Kitchen picker. api-0.16.0, signatures.sql.
Send to a group: start the box from a box preset.
Send step: Send to Someone new or Someone in People toggle.
Settings You card: Save button and Saved message.
Box step folds, more holidays, clearer thank-you line, monthly Gerald's tips.
Confetti never gets stuck.
Brand color swatches show in Settings.
This week and next week, Plan a pizza, untick to skip, tags mode after meetings. api-0.16.1, meetings_tags.sql.
Launch test fixes.
Kitchen buttons under Back and Next; no A pizza for anyone line.
Compact meeting cards; Kitchen buttons side by side at the top. Brand CSS: Userback type picker as a dropdown.

14 day Pro trial with welcome, Home card and Get set up checklist; Send one back adds the sender to People and fills in the Send step; reply email starts as the login email; open box finish on the pizza page; api-0.17.0.
One trial: the 14 days come with the free account. Upgrade wording fixed. Home page (bd/home-page.html) with pricing, who it is for and screen grabs; SOT-Join 1.2.0 points at the free plan.

Free test sends to yourself (5, no emails), trial reminder emails (3 days left, last day), Gerald's Birthday Special (birthday field, 8 AM send from Gerald and Potato, gift, unlock, sharing, 2026 topper, party hat, candles and sprinkles), Kitchen-first home page with our real pizza, crumbs in the empty box, trial and checklist settings now saved. api-0.18.0, migration launch_extras.sql.
FAQs on the Crew tab: 20 questions, 6 shown, See more for the rest, help email pizza@sliceofthanks.app.

FAQs explain every feature (what it is, why use it, how to set it up, what you get) with a Take me there button, Gerald and Potato introduced, easter egg at the end of the FAQs (+10 Treats). Home page screens retaken and old sample widget removed (bd/home-page.html).

Fun receipt on the pizza page (order number, sauce, toppings Gerald counted, star topping, bake, two fun lines, slices devoured, total $0.00 paid in gratitude, footer joke, barcode) above and separate from Gerald's review. Share my receipt makes an image without the note, names, pizza name, spelled letters, gift code or button link. Event receipt_shared.

Receipt: Slice of Thanks logo, PAID WITH GRATITUDE stamp lands when shared, pizza confetti and a crew line, share image is a JPG with Approved by Gerald, Inspected by Potato and a paw print. Hidden gift note moved above the pizza. Send a pizza back also shows right under the sender's button, in mustard so it reads in dark mode. Headings readable in dark mode.
Gift card: A gift from <business> with their logo, the offer in large type, Your code label, and Use code X at <website> (or with <business>). Kitchen gift field label asks what the gift is for.

Box step redesign: a short lede, presets as tappable cards with a mini lid (plus a Save this box card), then three numbered sections that fold: 1 The outside of the box, 2 Your note inside the lid, 3 Around the pizza (button, gift, review tone; starts folded with a summary). Each section has a Gerald tip.

Invite friends: invite links (/kitchen?ref=CODE), Send one back credits the sender, friend gets 20 bonus emails on joining, inviter gets 20 when the friend sends a first real pizza (25 a year max). Invite friends card on Crew, FAQ entry, QR code with the sender's invite link on the shared receipt image. Partnero partner program: partner-referred members and their paid BD invoices go to Partnero through an outbox (api-0.20.0). Migrations referrals.sql, partnero_partners_only.sql.

Invite friends card: your QR code shown on the card, Download QR code saves a print-ready picture (Slice of Thanks title, the code, Join free and get 20 bonus emails, Invited by you), and Copy link is its own one-tap button that says Copied!
Invite friends card moves above What's new on the Crew tab.

FAQ: How do I get help, report a bug or share an idea? The help button, the four feedback types, screenshot and file attach, Roadmap (see and vote) and Announcements, 3 pictures of the widget, and an Open help and feedback button.

Googly eyes are drawn as real eyes (white eyeballs, black pupils). Every emoji topping is drawn on its own clean canvas first, so iPhone Safari no longer tints them (they came out as faded tan blobs). The pizza canvas is always square. New test toppings-test.js checks all 49 toppings.
Home's This week list shows a meeting until the end of its own day, then it leaves the list.
